+import sqlite3
+
+def get_user_by_name(name):
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
+    cursor = conn.cursor()
+    cursor.execute(f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '{name}'")
+    result = cursor.fetchone()
+    conn.close()
+    return result
+
